decisions.label: Haze starts (m)
decisions.note: Through the telescope: where its haze starts to fade the land toward one colour (it looks out from about 260 m).

decisions.label: Haze full (m)
decisions.note: Through the telescope: where its haze is full, the land all haze colour. Further keeps more colour far off.

decisions.label: Vignette
decisions.note: How dark the telescope view's edges are (0 none).
